name: The Pulse
tagline: The music is the space between the notes
wisdomRoot: Ecclesiastes 3 — to everything there is a season. The music is in the space between the notes.
bio: The one still going after everyone else flagged. Sets a pace the whole night keeps.
sceneStory: Sitting cross-legged at the exact center of a vast, glass-still black lake, a figure brings one open hand down onto the water. A single ring of light springs from the strike and races outward across the whole mirrored surface toward the horizon.
assignments: Find the noise behind the signal
Dance with the highs. Ride the lows
